[[578.19]] 138. De convincendo celeriter adversario [Sommer 1683 bis Winter 1685/86 (?)]

[[578.20]] [Sommer 1683 bis Winter 1685/86 (?)]

[[578.23]] In communi sermone ubi disputationi formali locus est, convincendo celeriter adversario

[[578.24]] adhiberi debent tum falsa verba, sed magis ridicula quam purgentia, quaeque

[[578.25]] pudefaciant magis quam irritent, deinde crebrae interrogationes ad rem pertinentes.
